claim: *Attribution provenance model.* A run contains consequential operations; each operation records its target, mutation, responsible pass, and retained evidence. Audit and explanation can be derived from this shared history.

topology.description: Run contains operation records; each record encloses its four provenance fields; views derive from the record.

bw_encoding: Run, record territory, fields, evidence and derived outputs white; record containment supplies grouping.
redesign: Run, record territory, fields, evidence and derived outputs white; record containment supplies grouping. Existing horizontal/vertical paths retained; no diagonal process-routing exception.
alt: A run points to an operation-record enclosure. Inside it are target, mutation, responsible pass and retained evidence. A downward arrow derives audit, debugging and changelog views. A thin white record enclosure contains white field boxes; derived views are also white.

review.reference: current authored SVG (not older D2 receipts)
review.outcome: Restored operation-record enclosure containing its four fields; removed field spokes and external detour. Run-to-record and record-to-derived-views remain directed.
review.strict_compile: zero warnings, overfull boxes, missing glyphs or errors

style_review.fill: Run, record territory, fields, evidence and derived outputs white; record containment supplies grouping.
style_review.bold: Bold restricted to panel/container headings; ordinary node labels and explanatory text regular.
style_review.routing: Existing horizontal/vertical paths retained; no diagonal process-routing exception.
style_review.shape: Ordinary boxes use modest rounded corners; semantic document, state, decision, marker and quantitative shapes retain their roles.
style_review.visual_review: Original source and candidate semantics compared; final-size native render inspected for fill, hierarchy, routes and legibility.
